amount_out_of_range: This product runs from ₹{MIN} to ₹{MAX}. How much would you like?
ask_amount_again: Sure. How much do you need? You can pick one of the options below.
ask_consent: May I fetch your details from DigiLocker and your bank to fill the form? You can say no.
confirm_saved: Confirmed. Now let's look at your offers.
consent_declined: That's completely fine. In that case, please fill in a few details yourself.
didnt_catch: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
done: Done! Your Spasht receipt is ready and a summary has been sent to you.
explain_1: Your EMI is ₹{EMI} a month for {TENURE} months. You repay ₹{TOTAL_REPAY} in total.
explain_2: A late EMI costs ₹{LATE_FEE} and can lower your CIBIL score. Insurance is optional, and you can say no.
explain_3: Closing the loan early costs {FORECLOSURE_PCT}% of what is left. If you change your mind, you can exit within {COOLING_OFF_DAYS} days with no penalty.
greet: Hi! I'm Spasht. How much do you need, and what for?
handoff: No problem. A loan expert will call you between 9 am and 6 pm.
insurance_off: Insurance is set to "No". Your loan is approved without it.
insurance_on: Insurance is included. The one-time premium is ₹{INSURANCE_PREMIUM}.
locked: Let's finish the three quick questions first, then the agree button unlocks.
manual_saved: Got it, thank you. Now let's look at your offers.
not_suitable: Right now this amount is high against your income. Our expert will talk you through the options.
offers: You have {OFFER_COUNT} offers. The lowest interest rate isn't the cheapest. After fees, {BEST_LENDER} costs the least.
otp: Type the OTP sent to your phone to confirm. Never say it out loud.
prefilled: Your details are filled in. Just confirm your shop address and mobile number.
quiz_intro: Now 3 quick questions, to make sure everything is clear.
rescue_call: Hi {NAME_HONORIFIC}, your loan application is incomplete. Shall we continue where you stopped?
unlocked: Great! The "I agree" button is now unlocked. Insurance is a separate choice, set to "No".
wrong: Almost! Let me put it more simply.
